## R4 snapshot safety — 12 November 2026

Root's explicit correction is recorded in https://github.com/Jetnity/jetnity/pull/1195#issuecomment-6822763677. The earlier plain-BEGIN artifact could inherit REPEATABLE READ: its catalog queries establish an older snapshot, and acquiring the subsequent table locks does not refresh that snapshot. A separately committed writer between those catalog reads and the locks could therefore be missed by the ordinary emptiness query. This is a confirmed source risk in an unapplied candidate, not an observed hosted data-loss incident.

The recovery now begins with these adjacent statements before any query:

~~~sql
BEGIN;
SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED;
~~~

This is the only SQL change. It does not depend on or alter the session's default isolation.           . /etc/os-release
          test "$ID" = ubuntu
          test "$VERSION_ID" = 24.04
          test "$VERSION_CODENAME" = noble
          test "$(dpkg --print-architecture)" = amd64
          command -v curl >/dev/null
          command -v gpg >/dev/null
          test -f /usr/share/keyrings/ubuntu-archive-keyring.gpg
          hma_tmp="$(mktemp -d /tmp/jetnity-hma1-pgdg.XXXXXX)"
          chmod 755 "$hma_tmp"
          hma_policy_changed=0
          hma_cluster_config_changed=0
          hma_policy_present=0
          hma_cluster_config_present=0
          hma_cleanup() {
            hma_status=$?
            trap - EXIT
            set +e
            if [ "$hma_policy_changed" = 1 ]; then
              if [ "$hma_policy_present" = 1 ]; then
                sudo cp -a "$hma_tmp/policy-rc.d.original" /usr/sbin/policy-rc.d || hma_status=1
              else
                sudo rm -f /usr/sbin/policy-rc.d || hma_status=1

            if [ "$hma_cluster_config_changed" = 1 ]; then
              if [ "$hma_cluster_config_present" = 1 ]; then
                sudo cp -a "$hma_tmp/createcluster.conf.original" /etc/postgresql-common/createcluster.conf || hma_status=1

                sudo rm -f /etc/postgresql-common/createcluster.conf || hma_status=1

          test ! -L /usr/sbin/policy-rc.d

          if [ -e /usr/sbin/policy-rc.d ]; then
            test -f /usr/sbin/policy-rc.d

          hma_policy_changed=1

          sudo install -d -m 755 /etc/postgresql-common
          hma_cluster_config_changed=1

          deb [arch=amd64 signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/ubuntu-archive-keyring.gpg] https://archive.ubuntu.com/ubuntu noble-updates main universe
          deb [arch=amd64 signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/ubuntu-archive-keyring.gpg] https://security.ubuntu.com/ubuntu noble-security main universe
          deb [arch=amd64 signed-by=$hma_tmp/pgdg.asc] https://apt.postgresql.org/pub/repos/apt noble-pgdg main

            -o "Dir::State::lists=$hma_tmp/lists"
            -o "Dir::Cache::archives=$hma_tmp/archives"

            -o "Acquire::AllowDowngradeToInsecureRepositories=false"

            -o "APT::Update::Error-Mode=any"
            -o "Acquire::https::Verify-Peer=true"

            -o "Acquire::https::Timeout=30"
            -o "Acquire::Retries=0"

          hma_pgdg_version() {

                gsub(/^[ \t]+|[ \t]+$/,"",name)
                gsub(/^[ \t]+|[ \t]+$/,"",version)
                gsub(/^[ \t]+|[ \t]+$/,"",origin)
                if(name==wanted && origin=="https://apt.postgresql.org/pub/repos/apt noble-pgdg/main amd64 Packages" && selected=="")selected=version

          hma_client_version="$(hma_pgdg_version postgresql-client-17)"
          [[ "$hma_server_version" =~ ^17\.[0-9]+-[0-9]+\.pgdg24\.04\+[0-9]+$ ]]
          test "$hma_server_version" = "$hma_client_version"
          printf 'HMA1 PGDG key: %s\nHMA1 package origin: https://apt.postgresql.org/pub/repos/apt noble-pgdg/main amd64\n' "$hma_fingerprint"
          printf 'HMA1 selected packages: postgresql-17=%s postgresql-client-17=%s\n' "$hma_server_version" "$hma_client_version"
          sudo env DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive NEEDRESTART_MODE=l apt-get "${hma_apt_options[@]}" --assume-yes --no-install-recommends --reinstall install \
            "postgresql-17=$hma_server_version" "postgresql-client-17=$hma_client_version"
          hma_no_system_cluster
          apt-cache "${hma_apt_options[@]}" policy postgresql-17 postgresql-client-17

          # Invoke the existing selector without changing it, PATH or a sibling
          # toolchain. These commands report versions; no database is started.
          HMA1_EXPECTED_PACKAGE_VERSION="$hma_server_version" node --import tsx --input-type=module <<'HMA_NODE'
          import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
          import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process'
          import { realpathSync } from 'node:fs'
          import localProofClusterModule from './scripts/db/official-truth-integrated-pilot-1/local-cluster.ts'
          const { findLocalPgBins } = localProofClusterModule
          assert.equal(typeof findLocalPgBins, 'function', 'local proof selector export missing')
          const run = (file, args) => execFileSync(file, args, { encoding: 'utf8', stdio: 'pipe', timeout: 10_000, maxBuffer: 16_384 }).trim()
          const expectedVersion = process.env.HMA1_EXPECTED_PACKAGE_VERSION
          assert.match(expectedVersion ?? '', /^17\.[0-9]+-[0-9]+\.pgdg24\.04\+[0-9]+$/)
          const packages = ['postgresql-17', 'postgresql-client-17'].map(name => {
            const fields = run('dpkg-query', ['-W', '-f=${binary:Package}\t${Version}\t${Architecture}\t${db:Status-Status}', name]).split('\t')
            assert.ok(fields[0] === name || fields[0] === name + ':amd64')
            assert.deepEqual(fields.slice(1), [expectedVersion, 'amd64', 'installed'])
            assert.equal(run('dpkg', ['--verify', name]), '', 'installed package content differs')
            return { name, version: fields[1], architecture: fields[2], origin: 'https://apt.postgresql.org/pub/repos/apt noble-pgdg/main' }
          })
          const bins = findLocalPgBins()
          assert.ok(bins, 'mandatory PostgreSQL17 binaries missing')
          const programs = ['initdb', 'pg_ctl', 'postgres', 'psql'].map(name => {
            const expected = '/usr/lib/postgresql/17/bin/' + name
            assert.equal(bins[name], expected, 'unchanged selector chose another root')
            assert.equal(realpathSync(bins[name]), expected, 'selected binary resolves outside the official path')
            const owner = run('dpkg-query', ['-S', expected])
            const expectedPackage = name === 'psql' ? 'postgresql-client-17' : 'postgresql-17'
            assert.ok(owner === expectedPackage + ': ' + expected || owner === expectedPackage + ':amd64: ' + expected)
            const version = run(expected, ['--version'])
            assert.ok(version.length <= 256)
            assert.match(version, new RegExp('^' + name + ' \\(PostgreSQL\\) 17\\.[0-9]+(?:\\s|$)'))
            return { name, path: bins[name], resolved: realpathSync(bins[name]), package: expectedPackage, version }
          })
          const receipt = { schema: 'jetnity.hma1.ci-postgres17.v1', keyFingerprint: 'B97B0AFCAA1A47F044F244A07FCC7D46ACCC4CF8', packages, programs, databaseStarted: false }
          assert.ok(Buffer.byteLength(JSON.stringify(receipt)) < 4096)
          console.log('HMA1_POSTGRES17_PROVISION_RECEIPT ' + JSON.stringify(receipt))
          HMA_NODE

  assert.match(accepted, /timeout-minutes: 20/)

  assert.match(accepted, /run: npm run check:setup:ci/)
  assert.match(accepted, /run: npm run check:operating-mode/)
  assert.match(accepted, /run: npm run test:accepted-store-native:\$\{\{ matrix.group \}\}/)
  assert.doesNotMatch(accepted, /^\s*(?:if|continue-on-error):/m)

  assert.ok(aggregate)
  for (const [name, family] of [['CORE_RESULT', 'verify'], ['PERSISTED_NATIVE_RESULT', 'persisted_native'],
    ['REFRESH_NATIVE_RESULT', 'refresh_native'], ['ACCEPTED_STORE_NATIVE_RESULT', 'accepted_store_native'],
    ['OFFICIAL_TRUTH_V3_UI_RESULT', 'official_truth_v3_ui']]) {
    assert.ok(aggregate.includes(name + ': ${{ needs.' + family + '.result }}'))
    assert.ok(aggregate.includes('"$' + name + '" != "success"'))
  }
  assert.match(aggregate, /if: \$\{\{ always\(\) \}\}/)
  assert.doesNotMatch(aggregate, /continue-on-error:/)
})
